caption: A transparent pitcher pours water into an empty clear glass; the pitcher level falls while the glass level rises.

clauses.text: The pitcher must contain water and be held at an angle to initiate pouring.
The glass must be empty and positioned directly under the spout of the pitcher.
Water must flow visibly from the pitcher into the glass without spillage.
The water level in the pitcher must visibly decrease while the water level in the glass increases.
